prompt: Add an 'Add Note' button to PersonDetailView. Clicking it opens a small modal form with a single textarea where the user can type a note. On submit it calls window.api.persons.update(id, { notes }) and closes the modal. The button should be in the existing notes section of PersonDetailView.
assertions: The save handler has a try/catch block where the catch logs to console.error AND calls toast.error() to notify the user
Imports and calls useToast for error handling in the save catch block
Has NO local 'declare const window' type declaration
All user-visible strings (button labels, placeholder, heading) use $t() not hardcoded text
Any scoped CSS uses var(--color-*) or var(--font-*) variables, not hardcoded hex values
